about: Modwerk source-only quick-velocity-aftertouch-assign package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/quick-velocity-aftertouch-assign.

mods.title: Improved Modulation
mods.summary: Hold FIX, CHRO or LFO and turn a knob to link it to velocity, aftertouch or the LFO; hold SCENE or PERF and turn to lock it in a scene or performance; record performance moves and scene changes.
mods.description: Hold FIX and turn a knob on a sound page to link that parameter to velocity, CHRO for aftertouch, or LFO to make it the LFO's destination; further turns set the amount or the LFO's depth, in the sound's own mod slots. Hold SCENE and turn a knob to lock it in the active scene (or the last engaged one, or the one scene edit shows) without opening scene edit; pads pick tracks, REC, STOP and PLAY copy, paste and clear the scene, and YES writes it into the kit. Hold PERF for the same on the performance QPER links (QPER + a pad picks it). In LIVE RECORDING performance moves and scene changes are kept and played back, and RECORD + YES writes them into the pattern as locks.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: earlier versions as recorded in TESTING.md. 0.6.0's source passed the test rig's cases on private development images (R606 to R608, the last the final source) and the author's hand test of R606; this package's own image ran in rytm-emu only.
